body: I think this is a good opportunity to rename `runJunit4` to `runJUnit4` or `runJUnit4Tests` as well, just in time for M1.

I actually don't think this feature ever worked properly.

I think the only proper way to implement it is to explicitly _exclude_ the "junit4" engine when configuring the `ConsoleRunner` if `runJunit4` (or preferably `runJUnit4`) is set to `false`. In other words, we need another flag that has the opposite effect of `requiredEngine` -- something like `excludedEngines`.

Similarly, I think `requiredEngine` should be replaced with a list of `requiredEngines`.

**Team Decisions**
- Replace `requiredEngine` with `includedEngines`
- Introduce `excludedEngines`
- Remove `runJunit4` (superseded by `includedEngines`)
- Introduce `disableTestTask` for disabling the standard Gradle `test` task

These have been added as _Deliverables_ in this issue's description.
This issue is _blocked_ because we first need to decide about the semantics of having multiple `EngineIdFilters` (see e76099200f1b05b5ab7ef8d643b688440e853592).

## Status Quo

`EngineIdFilter` is currently only used to _require_ a single `TestEngine` within the _entire_ test plan, which is very lacking in terms of support for multiple engines going forward.

As the number of engines supported on the JUnit Platform increases, users will need the ability to require one or more engines and to exclude one or more engines simultaneously.
## Related Issues
- #285
- #295
- #303 
## Deliverables
- [x] Convert `requireEngineId(String)` in `EngineIdFilter` to `requireEngines(String...)`.
- [x] Introduce `excludeEngines(String...)` in `EngineIdFilter`.

issue.body:
## Status Quo

Tags and engines can currently be _required_ or _excluded_; however, a tag or engine is never actually _required_. In other words, specifying that a tag or engine is required does not result in a failure if such a tag or engine is not present.
## Team Decision

Use consistent terminology across the platform with regard to _things_ that can be included or excluded from a test plan, test run, etc.
## Related Issues
- #285
- #295
- #291
- #303 
- #307
## Deliverables
- [x] Replace all occurrences of _required_ terminology with _included_ for tags.
- [x] Replace all occurrences of _required_ terminology with _included_ for engines.
  - The `requireEngine` feature of the Gradle plugin will be addressed in #307

## Team Decisions
- Add a direct compile-time dependency on `junit-console` in `junit-gradle.gradle`.
- Refer to the `ConsoleRunner` via a class reference within the JUnit Gradle plugin instead of via a hard-coded string.
- Remove all programmatic dependency management within the JUnit Gradle plugin.
- Introduce a new `disableStandardTestTask` configuration flag for disabling execution of the standard Gradle `test` task; default the value of the flag to `true`.

The _Deliverables_ have been updated accordingly.
